from eds.date_dim where fulldate =''', item(), ''' AND business_day_flag=''Y''')

,CASE

		AND DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= @DateToProcess
		AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
		THEN 'C'
	WHEN DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
		AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
		THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
	WHEN DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
		AND DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DateToProcess
		AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
		THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
	WHEN DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
		AND DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DateToProcess
		AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
		THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
	WHEN DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
		AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
		THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
END AS DEP_Account_Status
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT DEP_FACT 
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER CASA ON DEP_FACT.GAM_ACID = CASA.ACID AND DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID = CASA.BANK_ID 
AND @DateToProcess BETWEEN CASA.SCD_Start_Date AND CASA.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_TDMASTER TD on DEP_FACT.GAM_ACID = TD.ACID AND DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID = TD.BANK_ID 
AND @DateToProcess BETWEEN TD.SCD_Start_Date AND TD.SCD_End_Date
WHERE DEP_FACT.AS_OF_dATE = @DateToProcess)A;


DELETE FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
WHERE AS_OF_dATE = @DateToProcess;
